title: A control that gets an accent fill must keep a visible focus ring
rule: When a control's background changes to the accent (or any color its focus ring uses), check its own `:focus-visible` rule, not only the global one. A ring with a negative `outline-offset` is drawn inside the control, so an accent ring on an accent fill does not show. Give the ring a positive offset, or use `--fm-on-accent` for it, and add a test that reads the computed `outline-offset` and `outline-color` in both themes.
rationale: E40.3 (#445): the Document Fonts Activate button became an accent fill, but kept a shared inset focus rule with `outline-offset: -2px`, so keyboard users saw no change on focus.
